_note: push/333 Zombie Outbreak build. Generated by push/333_zombie_outbreak_build.gen.py from the push/330 and push/332 captures; do not hand-edit. Creates three hidden Patient Zero signature jutsu, the Vanquisher of the Horde badge and the hidden level-30 Patient Zero boss (CHUNIN, boss multipliers 2/3, gated rules ending on move), then re-sends both live quests as full records: Vanquish the Horde swaps the lvl-25 Zombie Villager stand-in for Patient Zero in both boss fights, gains rewards and the badge, and fixes two typos; Zombie Outbreak gains its checklist rewards and four text fixes. Both quests stay hidden. PLACEHOLDERS: Patient Zero avatar (zombie stand-in art), badge image (quest icon), jutsu icons (existing live art), pyramid ryo/tokens/prestige/clan points.

data.name: Zombie Outbreak
data.description:
Attention everyone! As I’m sure you’re aware, the Headless Horseman has been spotted around Seichi recently, and a group of his followers accompanied him. Among them was an infected villager that was more zombie than villager.

One of those infected wandered off and attacked a village nearby and now we have a big mess on our hands. Can you go and check in with the village and see if there’s anything you can do to help?
data.successDescription: You did it! You stopped the outbreak from spreading! But you can't help but wonder how it began..

objectives.description: Thank you for coming! We managed to lock the guy who attacked up, but some of the villagers have been acting... odd. Can you check up on them?
They all seem to have odd scratches on them, it almost looks like bites..
You try to make a cure but you don’t have enough information so you are unsuccessful.
objectives.successDescription: You try to make a cure but you don’t have enough information so you are unsuccessful.

objectives.description: After closer inspection you find a small cut that’s clearly infected with something. You’ll need to do a few tests to isolate the virus. Better head to the lab.
You arrive at the lab and start conducting your tests, making quick work of it but in order to start creating a cure it requires something to stop the virus travelling through the blood system.

objectives.successDescription: You mix the Silverthorn into the cure but it has a violent reaction, making the virus even stronger than before.
You added the Icewardon root but it took over the cure and froze it solid, making it unusable.

objectives.description: You successfully combine the Frostbite Leaf, bringing your research dangerously close to producing a perfect cure. The formula is nearly complete, but something is still missing. One final component is needed: a unique strain of the virus, obtainable only from someone who has been completely consumed by the infection.
You've defeated the zombie, now you just need to collect the sample!
